title: Peruvian Chicken Bowl
description: A flavorful and spicy Peruvian-inspired bowl filled with chicken, avocado, and a tangy slaw.
instructions: 1. Season the chicken breast with salt and cook in a skillet over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
2. Let the chicken rest for 2-3 minutes before slicing into thin strips.
3. In a separate bowl, mix together the diced red onion, chopped cilantro, and lime juice.
4. Add the sliced chicken to the bowl and toss to combine with the onion-cilantro mixture.
5. Serve the chicken mixture over a bed of keto-friendly slaw mix.
6. Drizzle Peruvian aji amarillo pepper sauce over the top of the bowl.
7. Slice the avocado and serve on the side or on top of the bowl.
8. Garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
